highlights.title: Transactions as a list on every screen
highlights.detail: Transactions, Subscriptions and the rule match list show as a list on the desktop too.

highlights.title: Days you can fold
highlights.detail: Transactions sorted by date group by day with a total. Tap a day to fold it.

highlights.title: Less clutter
highlights.detail: Dates are short. The account you use most is hidden. A card account shows as a card icon.
